nodes.label: Commodity Forward Settlement Data
nodes.rationale: SettlementData handles cash-settled and physically-settled commodity forward cashflows: the forward/future price is observed at maturity (or future expiry), the NPV is converted to PayCurrency via an FXIndex fixing on the FixingDate, then discounted from PaymentDate.

nodes.label: Commodity Forward Future Expiry Mechanism
nodes.rationale: IsFuturePrice, FutureExpiryDate, FutureExpiryOffset and FutureExpiryOffsetCalendar together let a forward reference a future contract's settlement price whose own expiry may differ from the forward's Maturity date; FutureExpiryDate takes precedence over the offset-based calculation.

nodes.label: Precious Metal Forward Represented as FX Forward
nodes.rationale: ORE models Precious Metal Forwards (XAU, XAG, XPT, XPD) using the FX Forward trade type rather than CommodityForward, treating the metal as if it were a currency.

nodes.label: Commodity Digital Option Trade
nodes.rationale: Priced as a spread of two vanilla commodity options at strikes K-Delta/2 and K+Delta/2 scaled by Payoff/Delta, with Delta defaulting to 1% of strike K but overridable via the pricing engine's StrikeSpread parameter.

nodes.label: Commodity Spread Option Trade
nodes.rationale: Built from exactly two CommodityFloating legs of equal cashflow count, one payer and one receiver; the payer leg is the long position in the spread payoff, and differing underlying units are reconciled via the Gearing node (also usable for heat-rate/spark-spread factors).

nodes.label: Option Strip Payment Dates
nodes.rationale: Groups multi-period Commodity Spread Option cashflows into strips by expiry via an OptionStripDefinition schedule; every option in a strip shares one payment date computed as PaymentLag business days after the strip's latest expiry.

nodes.label: IsAveraged Strip Selector
nodes.rationale: The IsAveraged flag on the strip's CommodityFloating LegData decides whether each calculation period spawns a European commodity option (false, exercise at the period's pricing date) or a commodity average price option (true, exercise at period end), reusing the same Calls/Puts/Strikes structure for both.

nodes.label: Calls and Puts Strip Nodes
nodes.rationale: Each calculation period can carry an independently bought/sold call and put, with LongShorts and Strikes given either as a single value applied to all periods or one value per calculation period; an optional BarrierData node adds shared barrier terms per option type.

nodes.label: Weighted Commodity Basket Pricing
nodes.rationale: Basket price = Quantity * sum(Weight_i * S_i * FX_i), where S_i is each commodity's prompt future or spot price and FX_i converts from that commodity's currency into the first commodity's currency, which by definition is the basket's NPV currency.

nodes.label: Commodity Swap and Basis Swap Trade
Commodity Swap Floating Leg Netting
nodes.rationale: RoundNettedFloatingLegs sums signed effective fixings across all floating legs sharing a payment date, optionally rounds to NettingPrecision decimal places, then multiplies by the common quantity; fixed legs are unaffected and processed normally.

nodes.label: Commodity Swaption Exercise Fees
nodes.rationale: ExerciseFees entries can be Absolute or Percentage of the notional immediately following the exercise date; a positive fee is paid by the option holder on exercise while a negative fee is received by the holder, with settlement lagged via ExerciseFeeSettlementPeriod relative to the exercise date.

nodes.label: Commodity Variance and Volatility Swap Trade
nodes.rationale: Its CommodityVarianceSwapData node reuses the same structure as an Equity Variance Swap, substituting a Commodity-typed underlying node, rather than defining a bespoke schema.

nodes.label: Composite Trade Notional Calculation
nodes.rationale: NotionalCalculation selects how the composite's reported notional is derived from its SubTrade components (Sum, Mean/Average, First, Last, Min, Max, or Override via NotionalOverride), independent of how the components' NPVs are aggregated.

nodes.label: Convertible Bond Trade
nodes.rationale: NumberOfShares = BondNotional / ConversionRatio; shares may be from a different issuer than the bond (exchangeable) and in a different currency (cross-currency convertible); all schedules (bond, call, put, conversion, dividend protection) support perpetual (open-ended) representations by omitting EndDate.

nodes.label: Convertible Bond Call Data
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes hard calls from soft calls, exercisable only when the equity price exceeds the Conversion Price times a TriggerRatio, optionally subject to an n-of-m observation window (NOfMTriggers).

nodes.label: Convertible Bond Conversion Data
nodes.rationale: Defines the equity Underlying, ConversionRatios, and optionally ContingentConversion (parity trigger), MandatoryConversion (PEPS at maturity), ConversionResets (ratchet resets referencing initial or current conversion price), or FixedAmountConversion (fixed cash amount instead of shares) - the latter disabling several other bond features.

nodes.label: Convertible Bond Dividend Protection Data
nodes.rationale: Adjusts the conversion ratio (or passes dividends through) whenever accumulated dividends between schedule dates exceed a per-period Threshold, using either Absolute or Relative dividend amounts, with up-only or up-and-down adjustment styles.

nodes.label: Convertible Bond Make-Whole Adjustment
nodes.rationale: On a call exercise, bumps the conversion ratio upward by an amount interpolated from a matrix of effective dates and stock prices (CrIncreases), optionally capped; outside the matrix's date/price grid no adjustment applies.

nodes.label: Mandatory Conversion (PEPS)
nodes.rationale: Adds a mandatory conversion obligation at a date after all other conversion dates, using PEPS payoff data (UpperBarrier/LowerBarrier and corresponding conversion ratios) to determine the ratio applied at maturity based on the stock price.

nodes.label: Exchangeable Convertible Bond Data
nodes.rationale: Marks a convertible as exchangeable into a different issuer's shares, requiring an EquityCreditCurve for that equity issuer's default risk and an optional Secured flag for share-pledge collateralisation.

nodes.label: CPI Swap Trade
nodes.rationale: Can be set up either as trade type InflationSwap or as a generic Swap trade, in both cases with one leg of LegType CPI (carrying a CPILegData block) and other leg(s) of any type; cross-currency CPI swaps are supported since the legs' currencies need not match.

nodes.label: Credit Default Swap Trade
nodes.rationale: The single required Fixed LegData sub-node's Payer flag determines whether protection is bought (true) or sold (false); CreditCurveId or an equivalent ReferenceInformation node selects the reference entity's default curve.

nodes.label: Quanto Credit Default Swap
nodes.rationale: A CDS whose notional denomination currency differs from its settlement currency; premium and hypothetical protection amounts are converted via an FX index fixing (e.g. FX-TR20H-USD-BRL) declared in the premium leg's Indexings node.

nodes.label: Credit Linked Swap Payment Categories
nodes.rationale: Splits leg cashflows into IndependentPayments (unconditional), ContingentPayments (paid only absent a credit event), DefaultPayments (paid only on a credit event, weighted by 1 minus recovery rate), and RecoveryPayments (paid only on a credit event, weighted by the recovery rate); all legs share one currency.

nodes.label: Cross Currency Swap Trade
nodes.rationale: Representable via trade type Swap (SwapData) or CrossCurrencySwap (CrossCurrencySwapData); the latter requires two Fixed/Floating legs in any combination plus optional Cashflow legs.

nodes.label: Cross Currency Swap FX Reset (Rebalancing)
nodes.rationale: The FXReset node inside Notionals lets one leg's notional reset each period to the FX-equivalent of a fixed ForeignAmount in ForeignCurrency using an FXIndex fixing; both legs' NotionalInitialExchange/NotionalFinalExchange flags must then agree, and an explicit starting notional marks the first period as on-the-run for SIMM purposes.

nodes.label: Non-Deliverable Cross Currency Swap
nodes.rationale: A leg denominated in a non-deliverable currency but cash-settled in a deliverable currency is modeled by keeping Notional expressed in the non-deliverable amount while setting the leg Currency to the deliverable currency, Settlement to Cash, and adding an Indexings/Indexing FX node (with optional InitialNotionalFixing) to convert flows.

nodes.label: Double Digital Option Trade
nodes.rationale: Pays a fixed BinaryPayout if two underlyings (FX, Equity, Commodity or IR, in any combination) are simultaneously in the money w.r.t. per-underlying strikes/collars (Type1/Type2, BinaryLevel1/2) at a single Expiry date.

nodes.label: Double Digital Option Underlying Spread
nodes.rationale: Optional Underlying3/Underlying4 nodes turn Underlying1/Underlying2 into spreads (Underlying1 minus Underlying3, Underlying2 minus Underlying4) of the same asset type, letting the double digital payoff key off spread levels rather than outright levels.

nodes.label: Envelope Node
nodes.rationale: Contains the Id, Type, Counterparty and NettingSetId elements common to every ORE trade XML regardless of TradeType, plus PortfolioIds and AdditionalFields; Id, Type, Counterparty and NettingSetId must be non-blank for ORE to run.

nodes.label: Envelope NettingSetId
nodes.rationale: A trade is only eligible for ISDA close-out netting if NettingSetId names a netting set defined in the netting set definitions file; left blank or omitted, the trade belongs to no netting set.

nodes.label: Envelope PortfolioIds and AdditionalFields
nodes.rationale: PortfolioIds assigns a trade to multiple flat (non-hierarchical) portfolios for reporting breakdowns (e.g. VaR by portfolio id), while AdditionalFields carries free-form informational custom XML elements (e.g. Book, Sector) with no analytics impact.

nodes.label: Equity Asian Option Payoff Formula
nodes.rationale: Payoff = Quantity * max(omega*(A(0,T)-K),0), where A(0,T) is the arithmetic (or geometric, via PayoffType2) average of the equity spot over the ObservationDates period, and PayoffType additionally distinguishes a fixed-strike Asian payoff from an AverageStrike (floating-strike) payoff.

nodes.label: Equity Barrier Option Trade
nodes.rationale: European exercise with a continuously monitored (American-style) single barrier; the barrier level must be quoted in the same currency as the underlying equity spot, and quanto payoffs (payment currency differing from underlying equity currency) are not supported for this trade type.

nodes.label: Equity Barrier Historical Breach Check (StartDate/Calendar/EQIndex)
nodes.rationale: StartDate, Calendar and EQIndex together let ORE check whether a continuously-monitored equity barrier was already breached before today using a historical equity index fixing series; Calendar and EQIndex become required whenever StartDate precedes today.

nodes.label: Equity Digital Option Trade
nodes.rationale: A cash-or-nothing payoff per unit of underlying (PayoffAmount in PayoffCurrency), European exercise only; Call is in the money above Strike and Put below Strike, both expressed in the underlying equity's currency.

nodes.label: Equity Double Barrier Option Trade
nodes.rationale: European exercise with two continuously-monitored (American-style) barrier levels defining a knock-in (option activates on breach) or knock-out (option deactivates on breach) structure that otherwise behaves as a vanilla European equity option.

nodes.label: Equity Double Touch Option Trade
nodes.rationale: Pays a fixed cash amount (PayoffAmount in PayoffCurrency) at expiry if the underlying has hit either of two continuously-monitored barriers (KnockIn) or has hit neither (KnockOut); only payoff-at-expiry is currently supported and no rebates are paid.
